categories.main_business_segments: Suzhou Poly Plastic Masterbatch Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the chemical fiber raw liquid coloring and advanced functional modified materials production and R&D. Its main products include fiber masterbatches, film masterbatches, plastic masterbatches, and functional masterbatches, with a focus on fiber masterbatches. The company also develops liquid colorants and COFs (Covalent Organic Frameworks) materials. It serves industries such as chemical fibers, plastics, textiles, and automotive interiors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced polymer composite coloring technologies, including masterbatch production via precise formulation and twin-screw extrusion granulation. It emphasizes original liquid coloring technology (pre-spinning coloring) for chemical fibers, which reduces environmental impact by eliminating traditional dyeing steps. The company also develops functional masterbatches with properties like flame retardancy, antibacterial, infrared reflection, and conductive fibers. COFs materials are produced at tonnage scale using proprietary process routes. R&D is supported by a research institute and collaborations with universities and research centers.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are chemical fiber manufacturers, plastic product manufacturers, and downstream textile and automotive industries. The company serves major domestic markets in China, especially in the Yangtze River Delta and South China regions, and has some international presence including Turkey. Its products are used in fibers for apparel, home textiles, industrial textiles, films, injection molding, and automotive interiors. The company maintains stable relationships with leading chemical fiber producers in China.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Suzhou, Suqian, Xiamen, Jiujiang, and Turkey (Gaziantep). Its main markets are domestic, accounting for over 97% of revenue, with a small portion of exports. The company benefits from proximity to major chemical fiber clusters in eastern and southern China. It also has subsidiaries and joint ventures in various Chinese provinces and overseas.
categories.supply_chain_position: Poly Plastic Masterbatch operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, producing masterbatch raw materials and colorants used by chemical fiber and plastic manufacturers. It supplies upstream raw materials like resin pellets and pigments and delivers value-added colored and functional masterbatches to downstream fiber producers and plastic product manufacturers. The company also provides technical support and customized R&D services to customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in original liquid coloring technology and functional masterbatches with differentiated properties such as flame retardancy, antibacterial, infrared reflection, and conductive fibers. It invests in R&D through its research institute, collaborations with universities and research centers, and open innovation platforms. Key projects include development of high-performance flame retardant masterbatches, nano-material dispersion methods, PET cooling and heating masterbatches, and COFs materials. The company aims to expand production capacity and improve automation and digitalization.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of masterbatches, liquid colorants, and inks. The company follows a make-to-order production model based on customer contracts, with some inventory for common products. Sales are conducted mainly through direct supply to end customers and supplemented by sales to distributors. Revenue recognition occurs upon delivery and customer acceptance. The company also receives government subsidies and investment income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading player in the chemical fiber masterbatch industry in China, holding a strong market position with multiple production bases and advanced technology. It competes with domestic and international masterbatch producers, leveraging its original liquid coloring technology and functional product differentiation. The company has established stable relationships with major chemical fiber manufacturers and maintains a competitive edge through continuous R&D and quality management.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 1.36 billion, a 13.86% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 114 million, up 14.61%. The company’s total assets reached RMB 2.13 billion, with steady growth in operating cash flow and investment activities. It has expanded production capacity with ongoing projects and maintains a healthy balance sheet with moderate leverage. R&D expenses accounted for about 3.8% of revenue, reflecting sustained investment in innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Poly Plastic Masterbatch emphasizes environmentally friendly original liquid coloring technology that reduces energy consumption and pollution compared to traditional dyeing. Its products offer superior coloring effects, cost efficiency, ease of use, and precise dosing. The company differentiates through functional masterbatches with specialized properties tailored to customer needs, supported by strong technical service and customized R&D. Its scale, quality certifications, and integrated production and innovation capabilities provide customers with reliable, high-performance materials.
